newsitem.title: UK: Three out of four British voters back Blair - poll.
newsitem.headline: Three out of four British voters back Blair - poll.

text.p: Three out of four British voters now support Labour leader Tony Blair after his landslide election victory on May 1, according to the latest opinion poll.
The MORI poll conducted for the Sun tabloid newspaper showed that 73 percent were satisfied with the biggest Labour election victory in history.
Forty percent of those interviewed also felt that the economy would improve after Labour ended 18 years of Conservative rule. Only 12 percent felt it would get worse.

Blair has fulfilled his promise to "land running" with a bid to break the peace logjam in Northern Ireland as well as offering devolution for Scotland and giving the Bank of England independence to set interest rates.
